title: Pelican: choose the visual world
question: Bond register is pinned (First Light, Skyfall, Spectre: classy, elegant, simple). The roll picked which Bond world carries the guided send flow. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Shanghai Glass
options.lineage: Skyfall, the Shanghai tower at night: black glass, steel mullions, one projected light moving across the panes
options.thesis: The send seen through a glass tower at night: each step a pane, each proven track a lit window.
materials: one travelling field of projected light
options.viewport: Four tall panes (Watch, Choose, Review, Send) split by hairline mullions; the current pane holds the light, the rest read as dark glass with state etched in small caps; capacity is a vertical light level in the Watch pane.
options.risk: Glass tips into frosted-glassmorphism cliché the moment a pane blurs; it must stay architectural: hard mullions, no backdrop blur.

raised.raise: Palette law: champagne lights only what is proven: a verified track, the send action, the capacity left. Nothing decorative is ever gold.
State is a mark, not a hue: every file state carries a glyph and a word: queued, encoding, sending, verified, skipped, failed.
One persistent next-step marker always shows where to go.
Color lives only on hairline edges and the light; text fields stay achromatic.
One luminous field per screen; everything else recedes to glass.

options.label: Title Sequence
options.lineage: The modern opening titles (Skyfall, Spectre): ink in water, silhouettes, one line of widely tracked type
options.thesis: Every step is a title card (black ink, one silhouette, one line of type), and the send run is the credits, tracks rising as they verify.
options.viewport: Full-bleed black; the watch as a silhouette in ink, left; one tracked line ('Forerunner 165 Music · 2.3 GB free') and one action. Choosing opens a quiet list under the line; sending turns the screen into rising credits of verified tracks.
options.risk: The most familiar Bond read, and cinematic pacing fights a task UI: motion must stay under 250 ms and lists as dense as a tool's.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding, in black tie
options.lineage: International airport sign systems: overhead bands, one message per line, monumental gate numbers
options.thesis: A chain of decision points: each screen shows only the next decision and its cost; the watch is the gate at the end of the concourse.
options.viewport: One band across the top ('Choose music → 24 tracks · 112 MB · fits'), one decision below it, free space as a monumental numeral.
options.case: Its topology is the guided flow, so it holds product clarity; translated into the pinned black-and-champagne it loses on Bond identification.
options.risk: Without its yellow it can read as a plain stepper wizard.

options.label: Cutting Bench Select Rail
options.lineage: A film editor's bench: work print on pins, grease-pencil crosses
options.thesis: Tracks as frames on a perforated rail; done frames crossed.
options.viewport: A rail crossing the screen, the album as frames.
options.case: Orange-grain world contradicts the pin; not the Bond world. Loses both axes.
options.risk: Orange owning a third of the screen breaks the brief.
options.kept: State as a mark, not a hue.

options.label: CRT Arcade Glow
options.lineage: Pixel cabinet screens, scanlines, phosphor bloom
options.thesis: The send as a phosphor stage.
options.case: Novelty against 'classy, elegant'. Loses both axes.
options.kept: Palette law: one color, one meaning.

options.label: Four-Shade Field
options.thesis: Four shades and a blinking cursor.
options.case: Pastiche against the pin. Loses both axes.
options.kept: A persistent marker for where to go next.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.thesis: Color confined to a hairline fringe.
options.case: Pastel white contradicts the pin. Loses both axes.

options.label: Gravity-Rain Garden
options.lineage: A surreal garden of directional rain
options.case: No purchase on product or pin. Loses both axes.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A refined dark desktop sync app: sidebar, device card, track table, one gold button.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar (Send, On the watch, Ledger), device card on top, the track table, Send bottom-right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every sync tool: the file-manager feel you ruled out.
